text_block_list.text: After visiting a shrine with Супер Крик...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Sigh...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list: It's not often you sigh like that.

text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm sorry. I just don't quite feel like
myself
today...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
But the air is so fresh here and I really
feel like I
can relax.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, back when we were
praying
at the shrine...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Did you wish for anything?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Goodness, about me? What exactly did
you wish
for?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
If it's something I can do, then don't
hesitate to
ask.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Oh... or is it perhaps something that's
difficult to
ask me directly?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Hehe! Guessing what it is might be fun!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Oh, I know!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
You want me to hold you in my arms,
right?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Huh, really?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: ...Hehe, just kidding!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
There's only one thing that's ever on
your mind,
Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
It's okay. I'm sure training will go as well
as it
always does.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I promise not to let all your efforts go to
waste.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: And I'll do my best to make you smile. ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Hmm... I can't seem to think of anything.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Despite the fact that you're always so
considerate
of me...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: I just can't read what's on your mind.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: That kinda makes me feel sad, actually...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик is feeling down. It looks like
her
spirits could still use some lifting...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик grins cheekily. It looks like
she's
back to her usual self.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
